manualReview.scope: Model/editor Quality v3 remediation review of EN-A1-L-0089; not an independent human or real-learner test.

englishNaturalness.evidence: Table number five and Room number two are natural short identifying phrases.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: Persian consistently renders number as شماره in the identifying context.

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: Dialogue-dependent tasks are ordered after exposure, duplicate exact-sentence assessment is practice-only, and hidden-answer retrieval remains the strongest evidence.

distractorQuality.evidence: Distractors contrast the two target phrases and unrelated recent targets.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: Generic story metadata was replaced where needed by scene copy grounded in the canonical setting and turns.

difficultyFit.evidence: Short noun phrases keep production load low at A1.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: Repeated exact target sentences may remain for practice, but only the strongest occurrence is scored; this reduces false mastery from repeated identical answers.

transferQuality.evidence: The target transfers from a table identifier to a room identifier.

overallCoherence.evidence: Scenario, turns, tasks and outcome consistently use number as an identifier.

learnerExperience.evidence: Runtime ordering and answer tolerance were improved, but no real learner test is claimed.

limitations: No independent human or real learner test has been performed.
The review is limited to the bounded identifying use selected for this lesson.
Audio prosody is not evaluated at this text stage.
Quality v3 remediation was model/editor reviewed; real learner evidence is still required before public-release readiness.
resolvedFindings: Persian copy is coherent and orthographically clean.
Story and learner-role rotation are maintained.
